Chiu1999.citation: Chiu, L.-F.; Liu, H.-F.; Li, M.-H. Heat Capacity of Alkanolamines by Differential Scanning Calorimetry. J. Chem. Eng. Data 1999, 44, 631-636.
Chiu1999.extraction: pdftotext -layout; Table 2 'this study' column read against the printed table
Chiu1999.method: TA Instruments DSC-2010, hermetic pans (to about 3 atm), sapphire standard, 5 K/min, 25-82 C; water check against Osborne 1939 within 0.05% on the average of four runs (Table 1, runs -1.64% to +1.62%)
Chiu1999.uncertainty: accuracy +-2% from the water check (pp.632-633); +-3% including impurities (abstract; Conclusion p.636). Not a standard uncertainty.
Chiu1999.pressure: hermetically sealed pans; sample pressure is the sealed self-pressure, not reported

Maham1997.citation: Maham, Y.; Hepler, L. G.; Mather, A. E.; Hakin, A. W.; Marriott, R. A. Molar heat capacities of alkanolamines from 299.1 to 397.8 K. Group additivity and molecular connectivity analyses. J. Chem. Soc., Faraday Trans. 1997, 93, 1747-1750.
Maham1997.extraction: pdftotext -layout; Table 1 MEA row and Table 2 MEA coefficients read against the printed tables
Maham1997.method: Setaram C-80 heat-flow calorimeter, 2 K scans, sample minus empty-cell reference run; n-decane check at 299-373 K agrees with literature (p.1747); temperatures within 0.08 K
Maham1997.uncertainty: 0.9% (p.1747). Table 2 MEA: a0 = 82.5 +- 8.7 J/mol/K, a1 = 0.275 +- 0.025 J/mol/K^2 (standard errors; linear form selected by F-test)
Maham1997.pressure: closed cells at the sample's own vapour pressure, treated as isobaric by the authors (p.1747)
Maham1997.dow_check: Dow 1981 MEA at 303.15 K, 164.6 J/mol/K, against 165.9 from Eq. 1 (p.1747)

selection: Maham1997 is the primary pure-MEA reference (0.9% stated uncertainty, covers 299-398 K). Chiu1999 is reported as a second independent reference; the routing must hold against both.
not_used: Hilliard 2008 Section 4.7.2 measured pure MEA but shows it only in Figure 4.7-3 (p.80); no table. Dow 1981, Lee 1994 and Lide 1995 are compilations or reports cited secondhand by Chiu (Table 2).
